errors.description: The cuff is spliced the wrong way. The navy/white seam runs ACROSS the band - from the sleeve-join seam straight down to the hem - so the contrast is a section of the cuff's circumference rather than the hand-side half of the band. The drawn '1/2' split runs around the wrist, parallel to the cuff's two edges.
errors.expected: a straight splice seam encircling the wrist at mid-height of the cuff band, with the whole LOWER (hand-side) half in contrast cloth and the upper sleeve-side half white
errors.actual: a seam running lengthwise across the band from the sleeve seam to the hem, with the contrast occupying the right-hand section of the cuff's circumference across the full band height
errors.correction: Split the cuff band into an upper and a lower half with a straight seam that runs around the wrist parallel to the cuff edges; put the contrast on the lower, hand-side half only.

errors.description: Because the split axis is wrong, this render is indistinguishable in kind from what a generic 'contrast cuff panel' would look like, and it is NOT distinguishable from its csplice-upper-cuff sibling by the upper/lower relationship the option exists to show.
errors.expected: the exact drawn option: lower half of the cuff band in contrast
errors.actual: a contrast panel on one side of the cuff's circumference

notes: Attempt 3 of 3 - UNMET, and a REGRESSION. ATTEMPT 2 (candidate-2.png) IS THE BETTER ARTIFACT AND A HUMAN SHOULD LOOK AT IT: attempt 2 has the correct geometry - a straight seam encircling the wrist at mid-band-height with the whole lower, hand-side half spliced in contrast cloth and the upper half white, button at the seam. Its only real defect is that the contrast fabric was rendered as a near-white cream that barely reads against the white shirt (a legibility problem, not a geometry problem). Attempt 3 fixed the colour and broke the geometry. Attempt 1 had the same wrong split axis as attempt 3, plus a curved seam traced from the drawing's rounded-corner line. Corrections oscillated between colour and geometry across all three attempts and never held both at once. Do not ship candidate-3.
